description: Governer's Office - Western l Province - The Rules of Procurement Activities related to the Fund of the Western Provincial Councial
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of "The Rules of Procurement Activities related to the Fund of the Western Provincial Council." It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for procurement processes within the provincial council system. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. It creates rules and procedures that govern how procurement activities must be conducted, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
